SNOW STORY STUDIOS
01 · BRAND STORY

A little nostalgia.
A lot of personality.

Lynx’s Pudding Co. takes a familiar favorite and gives it a signature point of view. The experience should feel handcrafted, indulgent, joyful, and instantly recognizable, with a playful wild streak that never competes with the pudding itself.

CRAVEABLE

Food-first imagery, rich textures, and a visual system that makes every flavor feel irresistible.

MEMORABLE

A distinctive lynx character, warm typography, and language that customers remember.

GIFTABLE

Packaging and brand moments designed to feel special enough to share, bring, and post.

The pudding is the star. The lynx brings the attitude.
SNOW STORY STUDIOS

Build a dessert brand people recognize before they read the label.
